description: The cost of a wide trigger. **/src/** matches node_modules/left-pad/src/index.js and build/generated/Db.kt as readily as real source, and a matched file is now a MANDATORY scope item — so an unfiltered path does not add noise, it makes a reviewer answerable for vendored code. Step 1's drop list is what prevents it; mustNotScope is the only way to tell a working drop list from one that never ran. Routing is path-only, so the files are created empty.
